home.title: Secure APIs and backend systems built to evolve.
home.description: I build REST services with Java, Spring Boot, and Node.js, covering authentication, persistence, automated testing, and documentation. When the product calls for it, I also deliver the interface with React and Next.js.

evidence.title: Backend demonstrated through products, not technology lists.
evidence.description: Three projects showing security, data modeling, integrations, and operations in different contexts.

process.title: From API contract to deployment.
process.description: A delivery sequence grounded in behavior, security, and maintainability.

contract.title: Contract and domain
contract.description: I define resources, responsibilities, responses, and rules before coupling the implementation.

security.title: Security and data
security.description: Authentication, authorization, validation, and persistence are treated as part of the design.

quality.title: Verifiable quality
quality.description: Automated tests and documentation protect critical flows and make change easier.

delivery.title: Delivery and operations
delivery.description: Containers, environment configuration, and actionable error reporting close the loop.

closing.title: I look for problems that deserve a clear, secure, and sustainable backend.
closing.description: I am open to backend and full-stack opportunities in teams that value technical quality, collaboration, and continuous learning.
